updates.content:
Title: The Microsoft Defender portal isn't displaying affected products for some Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs)

User impact: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management Admins cannot see certain CVE affected products for PHP2SHELL CVEs.

More info: The API listed below is not working when directly called and not displaying affected products as expected in the UI.
/api/vulnerabilities/{vulnerabilityId}/affectedProducts/ 

Current status: We've determined that limitations on the values returned by the affected API resulted in this impact. We've developed a solution which we are rolling out to our internal environment, after which we will test to validate it fully remediates the issue before rolling out throughout the impacted environment. We expect we will be able to complete the validation and further rollout to resolve impact by Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 1:00 AM UTC.

Scope of impact: Admins attempting to view affected products within the UI or using the affected API are impacted.

Start time: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A limitation on the values returned by the API leads to the affected API not returning any results. 

Next update by: Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC
